changes.previous_text: The penalty fee is not limited to documentation/cooperation failures. Minor cases are excluded (§ 37); § 38 prevents specified overlap with a conditional-fine proceeding. Severity and extent affect the amount, and reduction is possible (§ 39).
changes.public_text: The penalty fee covers the obligations listed in § 37, including accessibility. Minor cases are excluded. Section 38 limits overlap with conditional-fine proceedings. The amount depends on the seriousness and extent of the breach and may be reduced (§ 39).
